chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Mu'ammar ibn Khallad, said:
I asked Aba al-Hasan عليه السلام about performing sajdah on snow. He said: Do not perform sajdah on saline ground, nor on snow.

key_terms.الثَّلْجِ: snow, mentioned here as a surface on which sajdah is not to be performed

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform sajdah on snow in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the validity of sajdah on certain surfaces. Aba al-Hasan عليه السلام forbids performing sajdah on saline ground and on snow, indicating that such surfaces are not suitable for sajdah.
